title: RepoAssure Evidence Integrity Hashing v0.1
objective: Implement content hashing for emitted artifacts and a verification command that recomputes and compares them, then correct every surface that currently describes artifacts as signed. Replace composed website demonstration figures with recorded benchmark output.
acceptance: Emitted run manifests record a content hash for every artifact file they index.
A verification command recomputes artifact hashes and reports match or mismatch per file.
Verification detects a modified artifact and reports it as a mismatch.
No surface describes artifacts as signed or cryptographically signed. Terminology is content-hashed and independently verifiable.
docs/PRD.md no longer claims signed evidence.
Website demonstration figures are sourced from recorded benchmark output and are internally consistent.
Forbidden-claim patterns are extended to cover unimplemented integrity claims.
Unit tests, typecheck, lint, and build pass.
